newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbekistan appoints new communications minister.
newsitem.headline: Uzbekistan appoints new communications minister.

text.p: Uzbekistan's President Islam Karimov has appointed Abduvokhid Dzhurabayev minister of communications, according to a presidential decree issued on Thursday.
His predecessor, Tahir Rakhimov, was recently appointed minister of foreign economic relations.
The oil-producing Central Asian state is modernising its Soviet-era telephone systems with a series of projects worth millions of dollars.
